hypothesis_candidates.baseline: zero-return cash primary; identical-interval SPY and QQQ secondary
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: select at most the top two liquid PIT-active common stocks per signal date when five-session median average dollar trade size reaches the preceding-126-session 90th percentile, at least four of five days exceed the prior median, every recent day's dynamic z is below 3, dollar participation does not fall, and the five-day tape is nonnegative; enter next open, hold five sessions, and admit no more than three simultaneous research positions
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: a robust multi-session change in dollars per reported transaction and participation can reflect a persistent execution/reporting state with incomplete price discovery; the explicit dynamic-z ceiling makes it distinct from a one-day block outlier, while unsigned daily aggregates do not identify institutions or direction
hypothesis_candidates.expected_horizon: next regular-session open through the fifth-session exit
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: same USD4000 notional and clock versus cash, SPY, and QQQ after 35bp round-trip cost; double-cost stress required
hypothesis_candidates.execution_envelope: research-only liquid U.S. common stock, USD4000 per name, at most three simultaneous positions and USD12000 reserved cash, latest-five median dollar volume at least max(USD1m, prior-20 median), close at least USD3, ten-session ticker cooldown, missing execution rows fail closed, no borrow/options/leverage, trade disabled
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: reject unless after-cost aggregate value is positive versus cash and above both identical-interval benchmarks, at least two canonical windows are positive, every window has at least five touches, double costs remain positive, and no ticker exceeds 15% of selections
hypothesis_candidates.readiness: 183 outcome-blind historical replay rows with entry/exit-row existence; executable touches 33/75/75; 177 tickers; max ticker share 1.093%; observed maximum concurrency 3; source contract pass; research PIT; novelty blocking_matches=[]; forward settled rows remain 0 and the result ceiling is observed_only

hypothesis_candidates.treatment: apply the unchanged advisory severity policy under the frozen replacement-value contract
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: hard-stop and high-urgency states may avoid adverse continuation while preserving winner collateral

hypothesis_candidates.execution_envelope: existing held cash equity only; no new slot, leverage, short, or live order
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: the exact frozen concentration, separation, breadth, and cost bars fail

hypothesis_candidates.baseline: same-date lowest-RSI top one in the identical deep-drawdown cohort
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: same-date top one by the unchanged flow-strength times captured near-put-OI-share rank
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: large-order absorption combined with near-price option inventory may identify a short-lived stabilization state
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: same-date RSI top one primary; cash/SPY/QQQ secondary; identical clock, notional, and cost
hypothesis_candidates.execution_envelope: long common stock, one USD4000 slot, 10% NAV name cap, fail-closed snapshots, no live order
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: twenty settled paired disagreements fail replacement value, chain coverage reverses identity, or concentration dominates
hypothesis_candidates.readiness: 18/10 forward flow dates, 15 disagreements, 9/20 H10 settled disagreements, touches 0/0/0, source contract partial

selection_basis: It is the only generated mechanism whose source authorization, distinct market prior, independent evidence, known_at/PIT contract, exact three-source identity, candidate overlap, historical replay density, 5/5/5 executable touch density, machine-verifiable transmission, concentration cap, fixed replacement comparators, and cash-feasible research envelope are all satisfied outcome-blind. Selection did not use candidate returns, prior-family success rates, adapter maturity, or the quarantined pilot file.

contamination_quarantine.incident: A broad pilot recommendation file unexpectedly exposed outcome-bearing values during readiness inspection.
contamination_quarantine.discarded_bundle: the earlier q75/prior-60 top-one H10 roster and all outcome-informed ticker exclusions
contamination_quarantine.replacement_generation: massive_persistent_adts_state_h5_v1 was independently specified from the open mechanism gap and generated without consulting the excluded file or applying ticker exclusions
contamination_quarantine.policy: The file, values, tickers, and any mechanism learned from that exposure are excluded from generation, ranking, thresholds, and the frozen roster; no outcome-informed ticker exclusion is permitted.
